data.name: HUNTACORE
data.detailed_description:
Civilization is collapsing.

Mutated creatures have overtaken cities and industrial districts, spreading faster than humanity can respond.

Deep inside these hostile zones lies a rare substance Core a resource believed to be essential for turning the tide.

In HUNTACORE, you are deployed into the heart of the outbreak.

Your missions take you through devastated urban environments where survival depends on combat skill, awareness, and decision-making under pressure.

Danger is constant.

Enemies come from all sides, resources are limited, and every push forward carries risk.

Success requires knowing when to fight, when to advance, and when to pull back before it’s too late.

Complete your objectives, escape the zone, and prepare for what comes next or lose everything by staying too long.

Key Features

  • Dark Action FPS Combat

Intense first-person gunplay focused on momentum, positioning, and survival in hostile environments.

  • High-Risk Mission Structure

Each operation challenges you to push deeper into dangerous territory while balancing progress against survival.

  • Extraction-Focused Gameplay

Critical resources must be secured and safely removed from the field — escape is as important as combat.

  • Hostile Urban Environments

Fight through ruined city districts, industrial complexes, and abandoned infrastructure overtaken by mutation.

  • Realistic Weaponry

A grounded arsenal of modern firearms, explosives, and close-combat tools designed for brutal, tactical encounters.

  • Constant Pressure

Limited safety, escalating threats, and difficult decisions define every mission.

Gameplay Experience

Enter unstable zones where control is fragile and danger escalates quickly.

Engage aggressive enemies, manage limited resources, and make fast decisions in environments designed to overwhelm.

Pushing forward increases both opportunity and risk staying too long can be fatal.

Every mission is a balance between ambition and survival.

The deeper you go, the harder it becomes to leave.

Player Fantasy

You are not a hero.

You are a professional sent into places others can’t survive.

Your role is to operate under pressure, adapt to chaos, and extract value from a world that is actively trying to kill you.

Skill, judgment, and restraint are your greatest weapons.

Enemies & Threats

  • Mutated Creatures

Unpredictable, aggressive entities shaped by a hostile environment.

  • Hostile Human Forces

Armed groups and corrupted survivors competing for territory and resources.

  • Major Threat Encounters

High-intensity confrontations that test combat awareness and survival instincts.

Progression & Risk

Progress comes at a cost.

Advancing through missions increases pressure, resource scarcity, and enemy aggression.

Failure to escape in time can result in significant losses, making every decision matter.

Calculated risks can accelerate progress reckless ones can end an operation instantly.

data.short_description: HUNTACORE is a dark, action-driven first-person shooter set in a world consumed by mutation. Enter hostile zones, face relentless threats, secure critical resources, and extract before the city claims you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400F or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64 bit
  • Processor: Core i7-6700K or Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains realistic combat involving firearms and hostile enemies.
Players may encounter depictions of violence and moderate blood effects during combat.
The game features a dark, post-apocalyptic atmosphere and themes of survival.
There is no sexual content, nudity, or depiction of sexual violence.
